name: @uni-helper/desktop-monorepo
description: Package uni-app projects as desktop apps with Electron
author: FliPPeDround <flippedround@qq.com>

scripts.ci: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run knip && pnpm run test
scripts.prepare: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && simple-git-hooks && skills experimental_sync --agent codex -y

scripts-info.knip: Find unused files, exports and dependencies
scripts-info.release: Bump version and publish a release
scripts-info.ci: Run the full continuous integration pipeline
scripts-info.prepare: Set up git hooks and skills

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: pnpm i --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts --offline && pnpm run ci && pnpx nano-staged
